init.title: ConnectLife options
init.description: Choose general settings, or a specific AC to configure its external sensors / Matter linkage.

data.sensor_control_min_interval: Minimum time between external sensor updates triggering the thermostat/dry-mode control loop (seconds, 0 to disable throttling)
data.poll_interval: Cloud poll interval (seconds, ignored if polling is disabled)
data.command_refresh_enabled: Re-poll the cloud shortly after sending a command
data.command_refresh_delay: Delay after sending a command before re-polling the cloud (seconds, ignored if disabled)
data.debounce_delay: Delay before sending batched rapid commands (seconds)

data.thermostat_forcing_enabled: Force min/max temperature to hold the external sensor's target when not routed through Matter (bang-bang control)
data.dry_idle_mode: Dry mode action once target humidity is reached (fan_only or off)
data.humidity_hysteresis: Humidity buffer before switching dry/idle modes (percentage points)
data.matter_climate_entity: Hisense Matter AC (used for current/target temperature and mode when available)
data.matter_temperature_sensor_entity: Matter temperature sensor (optional, higher precision than the Matter climate entity)
data.matter_sync_timeout: How long to trust our own state after a Matter command before falling back to ConnectLife's reported value

error.invalid_json: The device configuration is not valid JSON.

user.title: ConnectLife
user.description: ConnectLife's login server only redirects back to a fixed, pre-registered address — it will not use Home Assistant's own external URL. If your instance isn't reachable at the default below, change it to match (you'll need port 8123 open and `/auth/external/callback` reachable at that address).

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.
abort.missing_configuration: The component is not configured. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, check the help section.
